params.body:
New public trends get their links automatically, judged the same way as the 49 of 2026-09-28.

**How**
- `packages/pipeline/link-trends.mjs` takes each public trend without a run in `trend_link_runs`, at most ten per run.
- For each one: its ten nearest neighbours by shared concepts. Twins (half the signals shared) are not neighbours.
- The deepen model (Opus 5.5) judges the neighbours from the new trend's side.
- Every proposed link is judged again from the other trend's side, with only the new trend as neighbour.
- Only a verdict both sides give is written (`setLink`). A trend is judged once, so a run only pays for what is new.
- `linksFor` takes the judge as a parameter, so the agreement rule can be tested without a model.

**Schedule:** daily at 08:30 UTC in `ops/crontab`, after the writer (07:00), guarded against overlapping itself.

**After merge:**
1. `node packages/pipeline/link-trends.mjs --mark-judged` records the current 53 public trends as judged. They were on 2026-09-28, so they aren't paid for again.
2. `bin/crontab-install --apply` installs the new line.

**Cost:** one call per new trend plus one small call per proposed link, about $0.20 to $0.60 per new trend at list price.

Checks: new `test/link-trends.test.mjs` (neighbours without twins and strangers; only agreement is written; a different kind from the other side is no link either); 962 tests, 0 failures.
params.title: New public trends get their links once a day, judged from both sides
